# nyczips ![](reference/figures/nyczips.png)

**Superseded.** Use the [nycmaps](https://kjhealy.github.io/nycmaps/)
package instead. The two objects this package used to provide are in
nycmaps, with the same contents:

- `nycmaps::nyc_zips`: New York City ZIP codes by borough, county, and
  post office.
- `nycmaps::nyc_zip_sf`: ZIP code tabulation area polygons with 2019 ACS
  population, in EPSG:2263 (the copy formerly here was in EPSG:4269).

They were removed from nyczips in version 0.0.1.9001 so that loading
both packages no longer masks one copy with the other.

``` r

library(nycmaps)

nyc_zip_sf
```
